messages:
acme-customer-jd: Hey, our CI (token: ci-acme-42) is still being billed despite the trial credits showing in the org dashboard. Console: 1200 credits left. API responses show usage and account balance decreasing. Can you check?

sara-support: Sorry about that — can you paste the service key id you used for the CI job? Any correlation_id from the failed call?

acme-customer-jd: service_key: sk_live_acme_ci_001. Example call: `curl -s -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_acme_ci_001' -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"reds-medium","input":"hi"}'` -> returns 200 but invoice/usage meters show token_count and cost. Correlation header: x-corr-id: c1234-eu-9

sara-support: thanks. I pulled the org: acme-org-88. Dashboard shows org promo grant (trial-promo-2025) 1200 credits, expires 2026-04-01. Projects: acme-project-main and acme-project-ci. The service key sk_live_acme_ci_001 is scoped to acme-project-ci and shows billing_account_id: bill-eu-77. The promo is attached to billing_account_id: bill-us-11.

mike-billing: interesting — looks like a billing account mismatch across regions. If the promo was granted to the US billing bucket but the service key is routed to an EU billing account, our metering microservice will not apply the org credit. Need to confirm whether the project was migrated recently.

acme-customer-jd: we did a region migration last month for compliance. We expected credits to follow the org. Is there a way to force-apply credits to the EU billing account?

elaine-ops: @mike-billing can you check metering-service logs for corr c1234-eu-9? I suspect the charge pipeline didn't match billing_account_id and the promo checker returned NO_MATCH.

billing-bot: automated alert: promo-check failed for charge_id ch_9087, reason=account_mismatch, promo_id=trial-promo-2025, billing_account=bill-eu-77, promo_assigned_account=bill-us-11, timestamp=2310001248

mike-billing: got it. I searched logs: metering-service trace shows `PromoChecker: account mismatch` at 2026-01-07T13:47:28Z for corr c1234-eu-9. There is no fallback path. Two remediation options: 1) Reassign promo to bill-eu-77 (one-time, safe); 2) Create a temporary mapping so org-level promos propagate across billing accounts (requires infra change). For this customer, quick fix is reassign.

sara-support: I pinged the customer: would you like us to reassign trial-promo-2025 to bill-eu-77 so CI consumes it? If yes, we'll escalate to billing to make the change and backfill credits for consumed tokens.

acme-customer-jd: yes please, reassign and backfill. We need CI to use credits immediately — this blocks our release.

mike-billing: noted. I'll run manual reassignment and resync. Steps I'm running: `billing-admin promo-reassign --promo trial-promo-2025 --from bill-us-11 --to bill-eu-77 --reason \"region migration\"` then `metering-resync --billing-account bill-eu-77 --since 2026-01-01 --apply-backfill`. ETA ~30-45m.

tom-ingestion: tagging ingestion team — when the resync runs it may cause a short spike in metered events processing. We'll throttle if necessary.

acme-customer-jd: thanks. Will monitor. Any temporary workaround?

elaine-ops: temp workaround: generate a new service key under acme-project-main (which is still on bill-us-11) and swap the CI token. That will immediately consume credits, but it's a manual token rotation.

acme-customer-jd: prefer the reassignment.

billing-bot: change queued: promo-reassign job id pr-2310001 submitted by mike-billing at 2310001310

mike-billing: ran the reassignment, returned success. Then started metering-resync job mr-2310001. Initial scan shows ~1,200 consumed tokens eligible for backfill. Applying backfill; I will post final numbers when complete.

billing-bot: metering-resync mr-2310001 status=running, processed=0/1200 (0%), eta approx 12m

sara-support: pinging customer so they know this is in progress.

acme-customer-jd: saw credits appear as pending in console, thank you.

billing-bot: metering-resync mr-2310001 status=done, applied_backfill=1200 credits, adjusted_charges=0, timestamp=2310001452

mike-billing: done — backfill applied, charges adjusted, CI should no longer see charges. Please verify.

acme-customer-jd: Verified: CI shows no deduction, build passed. Huge thanks.

sara-support: marking resolved for now. Root cause: promo assigned to different billing_account after region migration -> promo-check returned account_mismatch. Action items: (1) Add cross-account promo fallback (eng ticket ENG-6821), (2) add monitoring alert when promos granted but project billing mismatches (ops ticket OPS-349), (3) docs update for region migrations and promo behavior. Assigned: ENG-6821 -> tom-ingestion, OPS-349 -> elaine-ops. SLO: 48h for initial ENG triage.

mike-billing: closing the billing ticket. If anything else pops up, reopen. :thumbsup:

acme-customer-jd: thanks team! :rocket:
